relationships.evidence_quote: Compound 44 (AGU654) demonstrated remarkable selectivity for mPGES-1 (IC50 = 2.9 nM) over COX-1, COX-2, 5-LOX, and FLAP

relationships.subject: AGU654
relationships.evidence_quote: AGU654 selectively suppresses PGE2 production triggered by bacterial exotoxins while sparing other prostaglandins

relationships.subject: AGU654
relationships.evidence_quote: AGU654 significantly alleviated fever, inflammation, and inflammatory pain in preclinical guinea pig models

key_findings: Benzimidazole mPGES-1 inhibitors reached IC50 0.27-7.0 nM; AGU654 is selective over COX-1/2, 5-LOX and FLAP
AGU654 suppressed exotoxin-triggered PGE2 in human macrophages and blood and alleviated fever, inflammation and pain in guinea pigs
